age.evidence: A 65-year-old man with a family history of progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) was evaluated for weakness and stiffness that started 2 years earlier in his left leg.

cell_type.evidence: We used patient induced pluripotent stem cells (IPSC) derived neurons from a patient with two mutations in KIF1A to evaluate the quantitative changes to KIF1A protein interaction, relative to wild-type control IPSC-motor neurons, using an anti-KIF1A antibody during immunoprecipitation.
the impact of KIF1A mutations on TDP-43 localization was studied using iPSC-derived motor neurons from the son.

Forearm skin biopsy collected from the KIF1AD136E, R1305H patient was plated in fibroblast growth media (minimal essential medium; Gibco, Evansville, IN; catalog number 11095-080) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (Thermo Fisher, Waltham, MA; catalog number 16000044), 1% non-essential amino acids (Gibco; catalog number 11140-050), and 1% sodium pyruvate (Gibco; catalog number 11360-070).
